parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A marker gene can be used when a gene of interest is introduced into a plant by genetic engineering.

Describe and explain how the use of a marker gene coding for a fluorescent product can show that the introduced gene of interest is being expressed in plants.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Give two advantages of genetically engineering herbicide resistance in crop plants such as soybean.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: DNA microarray analysis is a technique used in genetic technology that involves fluorescence. A DNA microarray has single-stranded probes attached to its surface. These probes hybridise to the fluorescently tagged single-stranded DNA that is added.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain why DNA hybridisation occurs between the probe DNA and the added DNA.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
A DNA microarray analysis can be used to identify the level of expression of some genes.

Describe and explain how the level of expression of some genes can be identified using the DNA microarray analysis technique.
